title: Stories and acceptance criteria: back-in-stock alerts
context: The epic is refined and the business rules are agreed (below). Tom (QA) asks you for **stories with testable acceptance criteria** so he can write test cases. *"Please think about the edge cases. That's where it always breaks."*

data.title: Business rules
rows: Sign-up only for out-of-stock products that are not discontinued
Guests sign up with an email address; logged-in shoppers with one click
Max one active alert per shopper per variant
Alert email sent within 1 hour after stock returns, only if available stock is at least 3 units
Service email: no marketing consent needed, so it must not contain promotions; includes an unsubscribe link

task: Write 3–6 user stories, each with at least 3 Given/When/Then acceptance criteria. Cover the rules and the edge cases.

parts.label: Your stories
parts.prompt: Write 3–6 stories with at least 3 acceptance criteria each.

keypoints.label: R1 discontinued / in stock: no sign-up
R7 no promotions in the email

rubric.full: Specific user, need not UI, real benefit
One action, observable result, numbers where rules have them
All seven rules traceable to ACs
Guest, duplicate, invalid email, low stock, expiry

rubric.partial: One giant story or technical slices

hints: Group the rules by moment in the journey: signing up, receiving the alert, after the alert.
Turn each rule into at least one "Given … When … Then …", and add one for what goes wrong (invalid email, signing up twice).
Three solid stories: (1) sign up for a shade (R1–R4 + invalid email), (2) receive the alert (R5 1 hour, ≥3 units, R7 no promotions + unsubscribe), (3) alert expiry and unsubscribe (R6, R7).
modelAnswer:
**Story 1: Sign up for an alert**
As a shopper looking at an out-of-stock shade, I want to be told when it's back, so that I can buy it before it sells out again.
- Given the selected shade is out of stock and not discontinued, when I sign up while logged in, then the alert is stored and I see "We'll email you when it's back".
- Given I'm a guest, when I submit a valid email, then the alert is stored for that shade.
- Given I enter an invalid email, when I submit, then I see an inline error and nothing is stored.
- Given I already have an active alert for this shade, when I sign up again, then no duplicate is created and I see "You're already on the list".
- Given the product is discontinued or in stock, when I view it, then no sign-up is offered.

**Story 2: Receive the alert**
As a shopper with an alert, I want an email when my shade is available, so that I can order it straight away.
- Given available stock goes from 0 to 3 or more units, when the stock update is processed, then the alert email is sent within 1 hour.
- Given stock returns with fewer than 3 units, when the update is processed, then no email is sent and the alert stays active.
- Given the alert email is sent, when I open it, then it shows the product and shade, a link to the product page, no promotions, and an unsubscribe link.

**Story 3: Alert lifecycle**
As a shopper, I want alerts to stop when they're no longer relevant, so that I don't get unwanted emails.
- Given an alert is 90 days old and the shade is still out of stock, when the daily clean-up runs, then the alert expires and no email is sent later.
- Given I click unsubscribe in an alert email, when the page opens, then that alert is removed and I see a confirmation.
- Given an alert email was sent, when the shade sells out again, then I am not emailed a second time for that alert.
commonMistakes: "As a user, I want a notify-me button…"
One AC per story covering only the happy path
Forgetting the 3-unit minimum and the 1-hour rule
